verdict.rationale: Codex lets a repo owner configure dependencies, tools, and setup steps per repository, and lists which external services (GitHub, GitLab, Linear, Slack) can trigger tasks, but there is no documented admin/lead-level permission system to explicitly allow/deny specific integrations. Community comments even raise concerns about unrestricted file-system access and lack of sandboxing controls, undercutting confidence in fine-grained access governance.
